children: Carlsmed’s third-quarter revenue rose 64.9% year over year, driven primarily by higher volumes of lumbar and cervical procedures, while its net loss widened. Gross margin improved to 77.3% from 75.9%, reflecting lower per-unit contract manufacturing fees and efficiencies in its digital production system.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Net loss per share attributable to common stockholders, basic and diluted”.
: More than 5,100 patients had been treated with the platform through September 30, 2026; trained surgeon users completing procedures increased 69% year over year.
: Rose to 77.3% from 75.9%, with lower per-unit production fees and digital production system efficiencies.
: aprevo bilateral lumbar surgery launched commercially in the U.S. in October 2026; corra cervical plating launch is planned for December 2026.
: From October 1, 2026, inpatient lumbar procedures using aprevo are assigned to new MS-DRG codes 523, 524 or 525.
